description: This Java source file defines an abstract wrapper class 'ConnectionLifecycleWrapper' that delegates all method calls to an underlying 'ConnectionLifecycle' implementation. It is used to add additional behavior or intercept method calls for connection lifecycle management in the Eclipse Hono client.

classes.name: ConnectionLifecycleWrapper
classes.description: An abstract class that implements ConnectionLifecycle and delegates all method calls to a contained 'delegate' instance.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Delegates call to 'delegate.connect()' to establish a connection.

methods.name: addDisconnectListener
methods.description: Delegates adding a disconnect listener to the underlying delegate.

methods.name: addReconnectListener
methods.description: Delegates adding a reconnect listener to the underlying delegate.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active, returning a Future<Void>.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active with a specified timeout, returning a Future<Void>.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Delegates disconnect request to the underlying delegate synchronously.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Delegates disconnect request to the underlying delegate asynchronously with a completion handler.
